definitions.explanation: A rest facility along expressways in Japan with gas stations, restaurants, shops, and restrooms. Abbreviated as SA.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧サービスエリア⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}もう→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: Let's take a break at the next service area.

examples.japanese: サービスエリア⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧ごはん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: We had lunch at the service area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧サービスエリア⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名産品|めいさんひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}っている→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Service areas on the expressway have many shops selling local specialty products.

notes:
サービスエリア (often abbreviated SA) refers to large rest facilities along Japanese expressways (⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧). These are a key part of long-distance driving in Japan.

TYPICAL FEATURES:
- ⟦ガソリンスタンド→ガソリンスタンド：01348_gasorinsutando⟧: gas station
- ⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧ / ⟦フード→フード：28535_fuudo⟧⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧: restaurant or food court
- ⟦{売店|ばいてん}→売店：01493_baiten⟧: shops selling ⟦{土産|みやげ}→土産：03746_miyage⟧ (souvenirs) and {名産品|めいさんひん} (local specialties)
- ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧ / ⟦{休憩所|きゅうけいじょ}→休憩所：07044_kyuukeijo⟧: restrooms and rest areas
- ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧: parking lot

SA VS PA:
- サービスエリア (SA): larger, full-service facilities with gas stations and restaurants
- ⟦パーキングエリア→パーキングエリア：25068_paakingueria⟧ (PA): smaller rest stops with restrooms and vending machines

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many SAs have become tourist destinations in their own right, famous for regional food and unique souvenirs. Some feature hot springs, observation decks, or local craft shops.
